description: This file contains functions and type definitions for inspecting, reporting, and managing plugin statuses and compatibility within the openclaw project. It includes logic for building plugin reports, inspecting plugin capabilities, and generating warnings and summaries related to plugin compatibility.

methods.name: buildCompatibilityNoticesForInspect
methods.description: Generates plugin compatibility notices based on plugin inspection report, warning about legacy usage and hook-only shape.

methods.name: resolveStatusConfig
methods.description: Resolves plugin auto-enable configuration based on provided config and environment.

methods.name: resolveReportedPluginVersion
methods.description: Determines the reported version of a plugin, normalizing for bundled plugins based on host version.

methods.name: buildPluginReport
methods.description: Builds a plugin status report, optionally loading modules, including plugin details and compatibility info.

methods.name: buildPluginSnapshotReport
methods.description: Creates a snapshot report of plugin statuses without diagnostics.

methods.name: buildPluginDiagnosticsReport
methods.description: Creates a detailed diagnostics report of plugin statuses.

methods.name: buildCapabilityEntries
methods.description: Extracts capability entries from a plugin, categorizing by capability kind.

methods.name: deriveInspectShape
methods.description: Determines the shape of plugin inspection (hook-only, plain, hybrid, or non-capability) based on counts of capabilities, hooks, tools, and commands.

methods.name: buildPluginInspectReport
methods.description: Generates a detailed inspection report for a specific plugin, including capabilities, hooks, servers, and compatibility warnings.

methods.name: buildAllPluginInspectReports
methods.description: Generates inspection reports for all plugins in the current configuration.

methods.name: buildPluginCompatibilityWarnings
methods.description: Returns string warnings about plugin compatibility issues.

methods.name: buildPluginCompatibilityNotices
methods.description: Returns detailed plugin compatibility notices for all plugins.

methods.name: formatPluginCompatibilityNotice
methods.description: Formats a plugin compatibility notice into a string message.

methods.name: summarizePluginCompatibility
methods.description: Summarizes plugin compatibility notices into counts of notices and affected plugins.
